text: To warn that pedestrians may be crossing the road for the next 2 km.
To warn that children might be crossing the road.
To warn the driver that there can be cyclists ahead.
To warn that there may be free ranging animals such as cattle, horses or sheep on the road.
To warn that there may be wild animals on the road or crossing the road.
To warn that there is a gate or boom across the road ahead.
To warn that there is a motor gate to the left or right or in the middle of the road.
To warn that there is a railway crossing ahead.
To warn that there is a tunnel ahead.
To warn that there is a structure ahead of which the height is indicated on the road traffic sign.
To warn that curves in the road or other structures on the side of the road make it impossible for vehicles longer than the length indicated on this road sign.
To warn that the road will climb or descend steeply.
To warn that heavy vehicles travel slowly down a descent.
To warn that the tarred road you are driving on will end soon and will have a gravel surface ahead.
To warn that the road narrows when crossing a bridge.
To warn that the carriageway ahead narrows to a width that will make it possible for only one vehicle at a time to pass.
To warn that the road ahead narrows from both sides.
To warn that the road ahead narrows from the left (W330, TW330) or from the right-hand (W329, TW329) side.
To warn that there is a depression or a ridge in the road, or that the road in general is uneven and potholed.
To warn that there are speed humps on the carriageway ahead which require a reduction of speed.
To warn about unusually slippery conditions on the road ahead.
To warn that rocks could fall on the carriageway from the left (W334, TW334) or from the right-hand side (W335, TW335).
To warn that there are temporary construction or maintenance works ahead.
To warn that a grader is working on the carriageway ahead.
To warn that there are loose stones or gravel on the road.
To warn that there is danger of some kind ahead.
To warn that the level of the right-hand side of the carriageway is higher than the left-hand side (TW340), or the left-hand side of the carriageway is higher than the right-hand side (TW341).
To warn that the material of the road shoulder may be softer than reasonably expected and could be dangerous for anyone who wants to move of the road.
To warn that traffic ahead is being controlled temporarily by a "Stop/Ry-Go" sign.
To warn that heavy vehicles regularly cross or join the road from the left or right.
To warn of a hazard ahead.
To warn about a temporary stop sign, a collision scene, roadblock or similar scene where police are on duty.
To warn that the road leads to a jetty edge or riverbank.
To warn about strong crosswinds that could force your vehicles off course.
To warn the driver that there is a drift ahead and that the road could be flooded.
To warn of the possibility of low-flying aircraft and sudden aircraft noise near the road.
To warn that tractors or other slow-moving agricultural vehicles could cross or enter the road ahead.

To warn the driver that - the road ahead may be obstructed, there could be pedestrians, rescue teams and police or traffic officers controlling the traffic at the scene, there could be wreckage, injured persons, animals or broken glass on the road surface.
To warn that there is a possibility reduced visibility on the road ahead that might cause a hazard to road users.
To warn that there is a possibility of congested traffic.
To warn that there is a possibility of horses and riders being present on the road ahead..
To warn that there is a possibility of elephants being present on the road ahead.
To warn that there is a possibility of warthogs being present on the road ahead.
To warn that there is a possibility of hippos being present on the road ahead..
To warn that there is overall width of vehicles restriction as indicated in metres on the road ahead.
To warn that there is a possibility of electrical shock from the overhead electrical power cables on the road ahead.
To warn that the gravel road you are travelling on will end ahead.
To warn that there is an obstruction or temporary obstruction next to the road and that the road alignment to the left or right hand side is altered.
To warn that the road ahead curves suddenly to the left (W406, W408, TW406, TW408) or to the right (W405, W407, TW405, TW407).
To warn that the road ahead does not carry on straight, but merges with another road.
